pages.title: W&C Glazing | County Hall Ballymena - W&C Glazing
pages.text: County Hall Ballymena You are here: Home Commercial County Hall Ballymena County Hall Ballymena is a government owned building which houses the Planning Offices and also the Tax Office. In this contract we were responsible for working along side a main contractor to revamp this building. We removed existing steel sash windows and replaced these with curtain walling aluminium windows, all fully double glazed with energy efficient glass. This contract was carried out while the offices were still in use therefore we had to work to a tight schedule with as little disruption as possible. Posted on August 8, 2013 Commercial Private Dwelling Saintfield Details Comber Mill Village Details Private Dwelling Crawfordsburn Details Related projects

pages.title: W&C Glazing | Private Dwelling Saintfield - W&C Glazing
pages.text: Private Dwelling Saintfield You are here: Home Residential Private Dwelling Saintfield We were approached by a local Building Contractor regarding fitting windows into a new house being built for private clients. In this house we supplied and fitted PVC sliding sash windows – these were installed throughout the house and also into a curved section of stonework. These windows can be supplied in a range of colours – and can also be dual colour ( different colour inside and out). We installed composite doors to the front and back. These doors provide extra security due to the locking mechanism and can be supplied in a range of colours. We also supplied and fitted PVC frames and glass. These frames provide a linkway between the front and back of the house and allow natural light to enter the premises. Posted on August 8, 2013 Residential Comber Mill Village Details Private Dwelling Crawfordsburn Details Related projects

pages.title: W&C Glazing | Comber Mill Village - W&C Glazing
pages.text: Comber Mill Village You are here: Home Commercial , Residential Comber Mill Village Comber Mill Village was originally “ The Mill” in Comber which was owned by the Andrews Family which were the main employers in the Comber area for many years. The Mill lay vacant for sometime until it was bought over and redeveloped into exclusive apartments and townhouses. We were the main glazing contractors on this job and supplied and fitted all the Aluminium windows and doors, and patio doors throughout this development. We supplied and fitted all the curtain walling on this development as well as many curved windows especially around the swimming pool and gym areas. We supplied and fitted dual colour Aluminium in this development white on the inside black on the outside– the aluminium can be polyester powder coated in a range of colours. Posted on August 8, 2013 Commercial Residential Private Dwelling Saintfield Details Private Dwelling Crawfordsburn Details Related projects

pages.title: W&C Glazing | Private Dwelling Crawfordsburn - W&C Glazing
pages.text: Private Dwelling Crawfordsburn You are here: Home Residential Private Dwelling Crawfordsburn We were contacted by O’Prey Developments Kircubbin who were the main contractors on this new build. We were asked to supply and fit windows and doors. The clients chose charcoal grey PVC throughout with a black composite front door from Apeer mono range and PPC Aluminium bi fold doors in the kitchen area. These bi-folds which W & C Glazing supply open up which allows masses of natural light to flood in and extend the kitchen out into the garden. Posted on August 8, 2013 Residential Private Dwelling Saintfield Details Comber Mill Village Details Related projects
